name: RMK (Russian Copper Company)
note: Listed as a sponsor of HC Avtomobilist on the club's sponsors page (archived 8 July 2025). Founder Igor Altushkin exited ownership in June 2023; parent Russian Copper Company Limited is held by private individuals (Levin 34%, Gorokhov 33%, Kozhukhov 3% plus Torivent's 30%) per Interfax. Left UNRATED on the company test: RMK's Karabashmed copper smelter in Karabash - a peer-reviewed study found blood and hair arsenic, lead and iron levels in children living near the smelter significantly exceeded control values (Skalny et al., Environmental Science and Pollution Research, 2018; published online October 2016, https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/27761855/), and NGO Pure Earth documents the Karabash smelter site with a population affected of 16,309 including 2,609 children (https://www.pureearth.org/project/karabash/). A maintainer should judge whether this is a finding of community harm under METHOD.md's company test.
